rules: A prospect is more likely to open when the subject connects to something currently important to her.
Current context alone is not sufficient. Identify which problem is likely to have the highest priority for her.
Expansion can create several HR problems at once. Do not assume they all have equal priority.
Hiring volume may make onboarding important.
Entering new states may make compliance important.
Fragmented payroll may make consolidation important.
When several problems exist, choose the one best supported by: current context, historical evidence, prospect behavior, likely business impact.
Connect to her situation — do not start with our product.
